groups.title: Power Regulation
groups.description: Documented power settings; changing grid operation requires an appropriate installation.

capabilities.title: Active Power Regulation Mode
capabilities.support_notes: Manufacturer 567/0237 V100B002D000. Readback confirmed in issue #23; writes untested.
capabilities.change_summary: Selects how the inverter limits active generation. Disabling regulation can remove an existing power limit.
capabilities.note: Selecting a mode does not set its limit. The existing kW or percentage setting is used; verify it before changing modes.

capabilities.title: Active Power Regulation Ratio
capabilities.support_notes: Manufacturer 567/0237 documents 0-100% with 0.01% scaling. Existing firmware values above 100% are displayed without expanding the documented write range. Writes untested.
capabilities.change_summary: Sets the active-power percentage of rated inverter power.
capabilities.note: Only used in Power Ratio regulation mode. Does not change the mode or configure site-wide zero export.

capabilities.title: Reactive Power Regulation Mode
capabilities.support_notes: Manufacturer 567/0237 V100B002D000. Readback confirmed in issue #23; writes untested.
capabilities.change_summary: Selects reactive-power regulation. Use settings appropriate to the installation's grid requirements.
capabilities.note: Selecting a mode uses its existing setpoint; it does not change that setpoint.
